note: Where each of experiment 01's places is, for plotting on a map. Located by Claude on 14 October 2026 with OpenStreetMap's Nominatim search, using the records' own descriptions to choose between results. `osm` names the feature the point came from. `certainty` says how far to trust the point: 'feature' is the building or structure itself; 'approximate' is a nearby stand-in. 'Town-wide' has no point and is left out on purpose. Coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

Roman villa site.why: R14 says the villa lies under St Laurence School's football pitch; this is the school's centre, not the pitch.

Budbury hillfort.why: The hillfort has no mapped outline here; this is the middle of the Budbury streets that now cover the area.

Barton (barn & bridge).why: The group also holds Barton Bridge, a short walk south-west of the barn.

Kingston Mill & The Hall.why: Midway between The Hall and the riverside mill site on Kingston Road, since the group covers both.

Avoncliff.why: The group covers the aqueduct, the weir and the mills; the aqueduct stands for all three.

Greenland Mill.why: The mill buildings are not named in OpenStreetMap; this is the street that bears their name.
